summary: v3.10 — SSE streaming endpoint POST /api/webchat/{tid}/stream verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 6/6 new tests in test_webchat_stream.py PASSED (404 tenant, error SSE on bad agent, happy-path event order ready->chunk*->done with TTFT 611ms over public Cloudflare/k8s URL [goal <1500ms], DB persistence of user+AI msgs after stream done, regression on /message JSON endpoint, widget.js __CP_ORIGIN__ regression). Full backend suite re-run: 59 passed / 23 skipped (legacy v2-only); zero regressions vs iteration 10. Frontend Playwright on /api/widget-test/{tid}/{aid}: launcher opens widget iframe with correct query params (api+tenant+agent), form submit triggers /api/webchat/{tid}/stream with text/event-stream content-type and status 200, Maria responds 'Olá! Sou a Maria, assistente de vendas da Consenso. Estamos aqui para ajudar empresas a automatizar a comunicação com agentes IA multilingue. Como posso ajudar-te hoje?', follow-up bubble ('Procuras mais informações sobre as nossas soluções?') renders in a separate bot bubble after the done event. UI repaints first-novel-text at ~1.9s observed (polling cadence + paint; raw network TTFT 611ms).

minor.issue: Returns raw widget.html without injecting tenant/agent into URL. The widget script reads from URLSearchParams (location.search), so if a user opens /api/widget/{tid} without ?tenant=...&agent=... in the query, TENANT is null and the widget cannot connect. Only widget.js (with __CP_ORIGIN__ + data-* attributes) and /api/widget-test/{tid}/{aid} build a working URL. Not a regression of this iteration, but worth a follow-up to either redirect or inject.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py webchat_stream() at L974-1119: clean separation between (a) the immediate validation (tenant 404 raises before headers; missing agent / not configured returns a streaming response that emits a single 'error' event — correct behaviour so the widget JS reader doesn't choke on a 500); (b) the inline conversation create/find (mirrors _process_inbound but without awaiting reply); (c) the async event_gen() with try/except wrapping the orchestrator stream; (d) DB writes (user msg before stream, AI msg after done) + ws_manager broadcasts; (e) background task fire-and-forget for execute_actions + qualify_conversation + lead notification. Headers Cache-Control:no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering:no, Connection:keep-alive set as required (Cloudflare strips X-Accel-Buffering on the public URL, but it still helps internal nginx ingress).

TTFT 611ms over the public URL (k8s ingress + Cloudflare) is excellent — well under the 1500ms goal. The raw OpenAI stream latency dominates; analyze_message/retrieve/history.gather all happen before the first LLM token is awaited, but that's fine because the 'ready' event is sent immediately and 'chunk' events flow as soon as orchestrator yields them.
Regression /message endpoint unchanged and still returns proper JSON shape {reply, follow_up, cards, conversation_id}; pytest test_message_endpoint_still_works confirms.

widget.html send() correctly: (a) creates typing dots placeholder before fetch; (b) hides typing dots on FIRST chunk and creates bot bubble; (c) appends chunk.text deltas to bubble.textContent; (d) replaces with final evt.reply on done; (e) renders follow_up + cards in a second 'continuation' row after a 600ms typing delay; (f) catch block falls back to postWithRetry('/message') when stream fails or returns !ok — protecting against CORS/Cloudflare/SSE-disabled environments.

MINOR (non-blocking, pre-existing): GET /api/widget/{tenant_id} returns widget.html as-is without injecting tenant/agent into the URL. End users must either (a) embed via widget.js (which builds the URL with tenant + agent + api params), or (b) use /api/widget-test/{tid}/{aid}. The standalone /api/widget/{tid} path effectively only works if the caller already passes ?tenant=...&agent=... — slightly confusing API surface but not a bug introduced this iteration.
lint pre-existing warnings server.py:635 'l' and server.py:1285 'backend' still present — not regressions.

data-testid coverage: widget HTML uses semantic IDs (#t for input, form#f for submit, .msg.bot/.row.bot for bubbles) which Playwright matched successfully. No new data-testid needed for SSE-specific elements at this time.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_webchat_stream.py -v -s (use -s to see [TTFT] print). 6 tests, ~8s total. The TTFT assertion is < 3.0s (tolerant for public URL); local single-digit-ms ingress will see 600-1200ms. The test_stream_persists_messages_after_done test depends on test_stream_happy_path_maria running first (shares pytest.shared_* attrs); pytest order is file-order so this works. For UI verification use /api/widget-test/{tid}/{aid} — the launcher button is at bottom-right (x>200,y>600 on mobile viewport 390x844). The widget iframe URL embeds api+tenant+agent as query params; this is critical because /api/widget/{tid} alone does NOT inject tenant — see minor issue in backend_issues.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. SSE endpoint returns text/event-stream with Cache-Control:no-cache + X-Accel-Buffering:no (last header stripped by Cloudflare CDN — expected, doesn't affect functionality). Order ready->chunk*->done verified. Persistence verified via /api/conversations/{conv_id} after stream. Cross-origin via widget.js __CP_ORIGIN__ regression validated.
